dominant_failure_factor: The observable spot-perpetual fair-value error was smaller than realistic round-trip trading costs even before waiting for a confirmation minute, so removing latency could not create executable reward-to-risk.
valid_components: causal separation of spot-led and perpetual-led shocks
pre-event basis as a contextual fair-value reference
explicit no-trade state when the convergence distance does not pay costs
invalid_generalization: A correctly identified cross-market leader-laggard event is not automatically a tradable day-trading opportunity; the remaining absolute price distance must materially exceed all entry and exit costs.
